reviewer: Independent Codex vision review (motion/character creative reskin)

projection.note: The edited blocks have changing/slanted side contours and phase-dependent placement rather than one stable square-grid raised surface.

complete-art.note: Every individual block and front wall is complete within its fixed panel. No extraction crop is used to conceal the later registration defects.

anchor-placement.note: The later sheet rows are visibly lifted away from their ground roots; the final row leaves clear ground below the blocks. The reference pairs expose this directly.

animated-height.note: The top/base extent and placement change through phases; the fixed-frame sequence breathes and lifts instead of keeping constant support and elevation.

spatial-seams.note: Phase-offset neighbors show obvious holes, stepped surface edges and disconnected lava features. These are readily visible at native scale, not a pixel-difference threshold.

temporal-loop.note: The last-to-first transition returns from a lifted final-row block to the initial lower registration, creating a visible jump despite valid12fps scheduling.

frame-consistency.note: The palette/material is recognizable throughout, but row/phase-dependent scale and placement leave the twelve frames unusable as a registered connected surface.

source-faithfulness.note: The processed atlas preserves the AI-drawn phase art and all visible drift under one whole-canvas mapping; no individual block fitting or geometry mask is applied.

motion-provenance.note: The retained3D capture contains authored shader phases; imagegen edits that complete atlas into new phase artwork. Fixed extraction only samples panels: final phase art is AI-redrawn, not newly authored post-reskin texture motion.
